# awscc_networkmanager_connection (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::NetworkManager::Connection. Describes a connection between two devices in a global network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connected_device_id` (String) The ID of the second device in the connection.
- `device_id` (String) The ID of the first device in the connection.
- `global_network_id` (String) The ID of the global network that the connection belongs to.

### Optional

- `connected_link_id` (String) The ID of the link for the second device.
- `description` (String) The description of the connection.
- `link_id` (String) The ID of the link for the first device.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `connection_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the connection.
- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the connection.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time that the connection was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `state` (String) The state of the connection.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key. Printable ASCII with at least one non-space character and no leading or trailing space, at most 128 characters, and cannot be prefixed with aws:.
- `value` (String) The tag value. Printable ASCII with at least one non-space character and no leading or trailing space, at most 256 characters, and cannot be prefixed with aws:.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmanager_connection.example
  identity = {
    connection_arn = "connection_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `connection_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the connection

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmanager_connection.example
  id = "connection_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_networkmanager_connection.example "connection_arn"
```
